observation: The deterministic slop gate reported a repo-wide clone cluster as a new finding although no clone was added: an unrelated edit shifted one already-baselined member's line number.

evidence.summary: Observed passed with exit code 0 for implementation sha256:338706ea3c372494a8cc7a3f96726ee0b8bf28a00fa603486335362713837fd4.

hypothesis: The baseline pins each cluster member by file and line, so any edit above a member invalidates the recorded identity and the gate reports a known, accepted finding as new.
validated_conclusion: Read a location-pinned repo-wide finding as a location change until proven otherwise: attribute it by scanning the base revision and the head revision with a cleared cache before changing code, and regenerate the baseline for a pure location shift instead of restructuring code the gate did not actually object to.
